test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If the recipient of Employee provident Fund (EPF) withdrawal does not provide his PAN, TDS on the withdrawal will be _______, instead of the maximum marginal rate as per new budget of 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• If the recipient of Employee Provident Fund (EPF) withdrawal does not provide his PAN, TDS on the withdrawal will be **0.2** instead of the maximum marginal rate as per the new budget of 2023.
 
• This measure aims to ensure that individuals without PAN are not subjected to excessively high TDS rates.
 
• Providing PAN helps in maintaining accurate records and ensures that the correct TDS rate is applied.
 
• It is advisable for EPF recipients to provide their PAN to avoid higher TDS deductions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Employee Provident Fund (EPF) is a retirement benefits scheme that is available to all salaried employees.
 
• Both the employee and employer contribute a part of the employee's salary towards the fund.
 
• The EPF is managed by the Employees' Provident Fund Organization (EPFO).
 
• Withdrawals from EPF are subject to TDS if the amount exceeds ₹50,000 and the employee has not completed five years of continuous service.
 
• To avoid TDS, it is crucial to provide the correct PAN details to the EPFO.
